name: City Centre & Lakeside
tagline: Around the lake and sacred temple
description: The heart of Kandy encircling the scenic Kandy Lake and the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, packed with hotels, shops, markets and transport links. This walkable core keeps most sights, restaurants and the train station within easy reach.
bestFor: First-time visitors wanting sights, transport and dining within walking distance
pros: Walk to Tooth Temple and lake

name: Aniwatte
description: A quiet, elevated residential neighbourhood on the hills northwest of the centre, popular for guesthouses and homestays offering views over the city and valley. Aniwatte gives a calmer, greener base a short tuk-tuk ride from the lake and temple.
bestFor: Nomads seeking calm hillside stays with valley views near the centre

name: Peradeniya
description: A green suburb southwest of Kandy home to the University of Peradeniya and the famous Royal Botanical Gardens. Set along the Mahaweli River, it offers a student-town atmosphere, open spaces and quieter accommodation a short bus or train ride from the centre.
bestFor: Longer-stay travellers wanting greenery, gardens and a laid-back campus atmosphere

name: Mahaiyawa & Around the Hills
description: The ring of hillside neighbourhoods rising above the city, including Mahaiyawa and nearby ridges dotted with boutique guesthouses and villas. These elevated pockets trade central convenience for cooler air, greenery and wide views across Kandy and its surrounding valleys.
bestFor: Travellers prioritising views, cooler air and quiet over walkable convenience
